comment: Although this class wasn't too hard, I found his lectures to become boring and repetitive at times. We get to bring in a cheat sheet for exams which made things a lot easier and he does really just want everyone to learn.

Econ 102 - Lecture style class. Exams throughout the semester, but we are allowed to bring in a "cheat sheet." 

A few extra-credit opportunities are available, and homework is very easy and completion-based. Attendance is not mandatory, but there are occasional pop quizzes to encourage attendance.
Professor Laumer was great. Fair professor who had good lectures and broke down material well. Easily reachable outside of class and is a super nice guy. Would 100% take another class with him.
